text:
Maria (AE): FYI we received an RFI from StratusOne — they want a capability matrix, answers to their security questionnaire, and a 30-day POC. Need to coordinate responses + a POC runbook.

Jasper (SE): I can take the capability matrix and the POC runbook. Do they require on-prem or will a Private VPC satisfy their KMS/HSM ask?

Lee (Security): HSM requirement is non-negotiable per their legal team. We'll need to be explicit on key custody and export controls (Q12). I can draft language for KMS/HSM and attach a short diagram of key flows.

Olivia (PM): Product note: feature parity across Hosted/Dedicated/Private for core APIs. Distinguish operational controls: Hosted = vendor-managed KMS, Dedicated = vendor KMS + optional HSM attachment, Private = customer-managed KMS/HSM. Mark as: "KMS options: vendor-managed / optional HSM / customer-managed" in the matrix.

Maria (AE): Sales needs two pricing lines: POC (30d) and 12mo committed Dedicated. Can finance provide a placeholder for committed GPU pricing? I'll flag it as indicative in the RFP.

Finance Bot: Placeholder rates: POC dev bundle = $5,000 (30d, includes 16GB GPU, telemetry). Indicative committed Dedicated starting at $18,000/mo per GPU unit (final quotes vary by region/commit). Finance to follow up with exact tiers.

Jasper (SE): For the POC runbook I'm thinking: 1) provision 1 GPU in a dedicated pool, 2) enable KV-cache + prefix caching for test suite, 3) run their latency/throughput tests, 4) verify KMS integration. Snippet:

```
# bootstrap
redwood-cli init --project stratus-poc --mode dedicated --region eu-west-1
redwood-cli create-env --type gpu --count 1 --image rwinference/poc:stable
```

Jasper (SE): I'll upload a CSV capability_matrix_stratusone_v1.csv and a POC checklist doc in a minute.

Lee (Security): Draft for Q12 (key custody): "Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, and integrates with on-prem HSMs using PKCS#11. Customer keys remain under customer control; Redwood uses ephemeral wrapping keys only for in-flight operations. Audit logs for key usage are retained and can be exported to customer SIEMs." Add SOC2 + pen test note too.

Olivia (PM): Add bullet about canary rollouts + automated fallback to smaller models for reliability during traffic spikes — they asked about graceful degradation.

Maria (AE): Please attach the CSV and POC checklist here so I can bundle into the RFP packet. StratusOne deadline is EOD tomorrow for the initial packet.

Jasper (SE): capability_matrix_stratusone_v1.csv uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/capmatrix/4876543210.csv

Jasper (SE): poc_runbook_stratusone_v1.md uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/runbooks/poc_runbook_4876543210.md

Maria (AE): Lee/Jasper — I'll stitch their questionnaire answers with the matrix and the pricing placeholders. Lee, if legal delays SOC2 excerpt, can we provide an S3 link gated for now?

Lee (Security): Yes — we'll provide a gated S3 link and an ETA for legal redaction. Also noting export control clause: we can sign a mutual non-export covenant; legal needs to review.

Finance Bot: Confirmed will provide exact committed pricing tiers by EOD.

Maria (AE): Great. I'll draft the narrative and ping for sign-off by 3pm PT. Quick ask: call out "audit logs, KMS options, HSM support, canary rollouts" in the short one-page summary.

Olivia (PM): Sending a short feature blurb now that you can paste into the narrative.

Maria (AE): Thank you! If anyone sees gaps in the matrix after upload, reply here. We need to avoid back-and-forth with the prospect before we send the initial packet. :pray:

Jasper (SE): Reviewing the uploaded CSV now, will flag any missing rows.

Lee (Security): I'll draft Q12 + SOC2 blurb and attach once legal gives the green light.

Maria (AE): Awesome — team, appreciate the fast turnaround. I'll assemble and circulate the RFP packet for final sign-off. :rocket:
